start.text: (A woman with a taped cricket bat.) Priya. I wrote payment software in Koramangala. Now I hit things. Rathore wants a gun to hide behind. I want to take it to HIVR and end this.

in.text: Good. You watch left, I watch right. Nobody runs.

later.text: Fair. I'll come anyway. Somebody has to watch your left.

palace.text: Twenty charges. HIVR has more than twenty of them.
